test_vectors: All six JSON value kinds, empty strings and containers, root aliases, exact nonzero byte offsets, and exclusion of outer whitespace.
Input slot order differs from document order; shared prefixes, overlapping ancestor and descendant spans, and repeated paths retain independent slots.
Missing paths differ from matched null and empty strings; scalar/container type mismatches remain missing without errors.
Numeric object keys are distinct from array indices; last valid and first missing array positions and u32::MAX indices remain bounded.
Allowed duplicate members retain each slot's first complete match, including later completion when an earlier duplicate lacks a descendant.
Container spans retain both delimiters, internal whitespace, numeric spelling, nested empty containers, and escaped quotes adjacent to nesting punctuation.
Raw-payload and decoded-arena strings include empty and multibyte UTF-8 content, simple escapes, surrogate pairs, and escaped control characters; borrowed pointers refer to the tagged owner.
Decoded keys match escaped punctuation, Unicode escapes, surrogate pairs, and empty keys without Unicode normalization.
Programmatic wildcard-looking, punctuation-containing, control-containing, and root-marker keys remain literal.
Numeric raw results preserve negative zero, decimal and exponent spelling, integers beyond u64 and exact f64 precision, huge exponents, and long fractional digits without conversion.
Results retain payload and decoded storage after caller input mutation, input and plan destruction, result cloning, and original result destruction.
Shared and Bytes payload backings preserve complete supplied bytes in strict and query modes.
Zero-slot strict queries still validate input; successful zero-slot queries expose no slots and retain the cursor's validation flag.
Query results and errors match direct cursor extraction, including optional early completion, invalid suffix handling, decoded references, full owner retention, and validation flags.
Missing query slots force EOF traversal; malformed suffixes propagate errors without returning partial results.

Exact error parity covers empty input, truncation, malformed containers, trailing content, invalid escapes, lone surrogates, invalid numbers, invalid UTF-8, and unescaped controls, including failures after a match.
Strict duplicate-key rejection includes equivalent decoded key spellings and preserves original error diagnostics.
Payload byte limits are inclusive and apply to all supplied bytes even when query traversal can stop early; one-byte overflow and zero limits reject input.
Inclusive depth, array-item, object-field, string-byte, number-digit, and decoded-arena limits accept their boundaries and reject the next unit with the cursor's exact errors.
Zero resource ceilings allow scalars that consume none of the constrained resource and reject containers, digits, and nonempty strings as appropriate.
257 repeated root slots preserve identical spans and cooked strings; first out-of-range, 65535, 65536, and u32::MAX slot arguments safely return None.
